> 第17章 被识破身份（第1页）
陆鸣嘴角一口逆血流出来。抱起那宽厚的大刀走了。
看着那离开落寞的背影，李天开口道到，希望以后不会是敌人而是朋友。我不会允许下一次一个敌人威胁到自己的生命。
陆鸣头也没有回，话也没有回。消失在李天的房屋外。
看着一片狼藉的院子，李天传讯令牌一抖动，叫来了自己外门管事爷爷王维，麻烦他叫人给自己重新建造一个。
王维看着一片狼藉的房屋，询问了情况，才知道又有人找自己孙子的麻烦。本想找执法堂擒拿那陆鸣，还是被李天劝住了，毕竟看那陆鸣也不是坏到骨子里的人。
李天告别了王老爷子，在远处重新套上自己的黑袍，前往天商阁。天商阁看到李天再次来到自己商会，很是高兴。
直接上三楼吧，还是原来那间，掌柜在等你。
燕姐你好，象征性的打了招呼。毕竟遇到这妖精般的女人李天还是有点扛不住，见到很尴尬。
林燕示意李天坐下，然后开口道，小弟弟今天是要买什么？还是卖什么？
林燕看着里面杂七杂八的刀剑。没什么兴趣，主要兴趣是看那几瓶瓶子里的丹药，打开一看，化凡境界丹药，血脉丹，三品极品。一瓶十颗这里七瓶化凡丹，七瓶血脉丹。五瓶疗伤丹，对天神境都有效的？
看着这百十颗丹药，林燕笑的合不拢嘴。小弟弟真的是很有本事哦，说着身体往李天身边靠了靠。
李天被吓得又挪了挪位置，与林燕保持着距离。
哎呀小弟弟姐姐又不会吃人，你怕什么，林燕笑嘻嘻的看着李天。
燕姐，我们还是赶紧做交易吧!我还有事，林天赶紧找个借口想要离开。
看着李天那穷迫样，林燕伸出两个手指，两百万加上里面杂七杂八的那些东西。
林燕想也没想一口答应，林燕拿出个储物袋，拿给了李天。
当心你们大长老田龙，以及执法堂堂主鲁剑。
当李天听到这话，顿时感觉不妙，对方查了他的身份，立马警惕起来。

在这小小的天武域。还没有我们天商会不知道的事。这天商阁只是分部之一。总部天商会，其余的都叫天商阁。情报、宝物、跟生意有关的我们都做。
你是元神宗内门弟子李天，前几天刚晋升内门，而不去内门住的人，这种宗门惊天大事只要有消息都能查到。
你放心我对你没有恶意，要是有恶意也不会告诉你危险即将来临。所以别用那种警惕性眼神看着我!
你的过往我天商阁都知道，就是很好奇小弟弟修为被废，一下子隐忍十年又一飞冲天的？
林燕笑嘻嘻的看着李天，好了好了不逗你了，每个人都有自己的隐私。我不打听，只是好奇的问问，说与不说还不是你自己说了算。
李天看着林燕那认真样，警惕心放了下来。

> Chapter 17 Identity discovered (page 1)
Blood flowed from the corner of Lu Ming's mouth. He picked up the generous sword and left.
Looking at the back of the lonely figure, Li Tian said, hoping that he would not be an enemy but a friend in the future. I will not allow an enemy to threaten my life the next time.
Lu Ming didn't even turn his head or say anything. Disappeared outside Li Tian's house.
Looking at the messy yard, Li Tian shook his summons token and called his grandfather, Wang Wei, who was in charge of the outer door, and asked him to ask someone to build a new one for him.
Wang Wei looked at the messy house and asked about the situation, only to find out that someone was causing trouble for his grandson again. I originally wanted to go to the Law Enforcement Hall to capture Lu Ming, but I was persuaded by Li Tian. After all, it seemed that Lu Ming was not a bad person at heart.
Li Tian said goodbye to Mr. Wang, put on his black robe again in the distance, and headed to Tianshang Pavilion. Tianshang Pavilion was very happy to see Li Tian coming to his chamber of commerce again.
Go directly to the third floor. It's the same room as before. The shopkeeper is waiting for you.
Hello, Sister Yan, I greeted you symbolically. After all, Li Tian couldn't bear it when he met this fairy-like woman, and it was very embarrassing to see her.
Lin Yan motioned for Li Tian to sit down, and then said, what does the little brother want to buy today? Or sell something?
Lin Yan looked at the miscellaneous swords inside. I have no interest in it. My main interest is to look at the elixirs in those bottles. I opened them and saw that the elixirs of the mortal realm and the bloodline elixirs were the best of the third grade. There are ten bottles in a bottle. Here are seven bottles of Mortal Transformation Pills and seven bottles of Bloodline Pills. Five bottles of healing pills, are they effective for all gods?
Looking at these hundred and ten pills, Lin Yan smiled from ear to ear. The little brother is really very capable. As he spoke, he leaned closer to Li Tian.
Li Tian was so frightened that he moved his position again, keeping a distance from Lin Yan.
Oh, my little brother and sister can’t eat people, so what are you afraid of? Lin Yan looked at Li Tian with a smile.
Sister Yan, let’s make a deal quickly! I still have something to do, so Lin Tian quickly found an excuse to leave.
Seeing Li Tian's desperate look, Lin Yan stretched out two fingers, two million plus the miscellaneous things inside.
Lin Yan agreed without thinking. Lin Yan took out a storage bag and gave it to Li Tian.
Watch out for your great elder Tian Long, and the head of the law enforcement hall Lu Jian.
When Li Tian heard this, he immediately felt bad. The other party checked his identity and immediately became vigilant.
In this small Tianwu Domain. There is nothing that our Tianshang Association doesn’t know about. Today Shangge is just one of the branches. The headquarters is Tianshang Guild, and the rest are called Tianshang Pavilion. We do everything related to information, treasures, and business.
You are Li Tian, ​​a disciple of the inner sect of the Yuanshen Sect. You have just been promoted to the inner sect a few days ago and do not live in the inner sect. As long as there is news about such shocking events in the sect, you can find out.
Don't worry, I don't have any ill intentions towards you. If I did, I wouldn't tell you that danger is coming. So don't look at me with that wary look!
I, Tianshang Pavilion, all know about your past, but I am just curious about how my little brother’s cultivation was crippled, and then he tolerated it for ten years and then soared into the sky?
Lin Yan looked at Li Tian with a smile, "Okay, I won't tease you anymore, everyone has their own privacy." I won't pry, I'm just asking out of curiosity. It's not up to you to decide whether to tell or not.
Li Tian saw Lin Yan's seriousness and let down his guard.
